members.title: Elon Musk, other tech execs sign petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang
members.content: In Brief Posted: 1:41 PM PST · November 14, 2026 Image Credits:Li Hongbo/VCG / Getty Images A petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate the company’s recently ousted CEO Jensen Huang appears to have attracted more than 115,000 signatures as of Saturday afternoon. The petition website said the signers include 5,965 current Nvidia employees, 1,108 former employees, and 63,063 shareholders. Notable supporters include Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk, Replit CEO Amjad Masad, Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney, and Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan.

members.title: Jensen Huang and the decline of the visionary showman founder CEO
members.content: On January 6th, 2025, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang got his rockstar moment at last. He strode triumphantly onstage, hand raised in the air, to the claps and cheers of a 14,000-person arena absolutely packed with influencers and fans, their faces awash in blue glow, as he made his entrance in a black leather jacket that shimmered in the stadium’s lights.Few are cheering for Jensen Huang now.

members.title: The AI graveyard: a running list of projects and startups that didn’t make it
members.content: Last month, chatbot platform Character.ai filed for bankruptcy just five years after launching. More recently, privacy-focused AI assistant Ollie announced its shutdown a few weeks ago. Aside from Character.ai and Ollie, plenty of AI bets never even survive inside the companies that build them. According to S&P Global Market Intelligence, about 42% of AI initiatives are ultimately abandoned by their corporate parents. The reasons vary: insufficient funding, technical challenges, competition, difficulty scaling, or just weak user demand. The result is a growing AI graveyard.

members.title: 国产大模型又杀出一匹黑马，引发硅谷关注！
members.content: 国产大模型，又杀出一匹黑马！ 而且这回，还是被硅谷超火的硬核AI技术媒体Latent Space亲自实测出来的。 就在11月10日，Latent Space推出全新模型测评栏目，专门做「不带立场」的新模型实测。 而栏目首期，其就把目光投向了中国公司NaiveAI的开源模型Naive-N0.5-Flash。 Latent Space选的对手还是OpenRouter上最热门的两款Flash模型：DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017和GLM 5.3 Flash。 没想到，这次被拉来和两个头部模型同台较量的Naive-N0.5-Flash，还真交出了一份颇有竞争力的成绩单—— 综合能力：介于DeepSeek V4.1 Flash与GLM 5.3 Flash之间，跻身国产主流模型第一梯队。编程能力：整体表现介于两者之间，单项评测实现反超；3D太阳系应用表现最佳，3D生长树与DeepSeek并列。推理速度：极速模式下单秒峰值高达2100 Token/s，思考与作答阶段分别达到984、1816 Token/s，中位响应时间仅3.1秒，成绩亮眼。 说起NaiveAI，这个玩家背后的创始人大家也并不陌生——清华大学电子工程系副教授代季峰。 而且这模型还有个相当特别的出身：模型架构、训练系统和推理优化，都由AI亲自参与研发。

members.title: 破局硅谷头号难题！中国AI「魂穿」老电影，神器全民开放
members.content: 大家平时没少看主角「魂穿」的小说，可很少有人想过，有一天AI也会玩起「魂穿」。 假如让AI穿越回1925年的黑白默片《淘金记》，直接代入卓别林的第一视角，睁开眼会看到什么画面？ 低头是自己双手握着刀叉，正切开餐盘里那只著名的煮皮鞋，抬头还能瞥见对面饥肠辘辘的大胡子同伴。 下一秒再切换到《夺宝奇兵》主角视角，幽暗古墓里左手试探机关，右手捏着沙袋把黄金神像瞬间掉包。 而在《侏罗纪公园》幽暗局促的地下配电室里，角色在仪表盘前紧急操作。 生成画面里，青色3D手部骨骼把手指一个接一个拨动发光开关的细微动作都还原了出来。 这一连串跨越百年的「赛博魂穿」，全部来自刚刚发布的全新跨视角生成模型Exo2EgoPolicy。 它能把任意第三人称旁观镜头，一键转换成操作者本人的第一人称视角（Ego View），并实时描出左右手每一根手指的3D手部骨骼（Ego Skeleton）。 魂穿影史百年名场面 镜头乱切也跟得住人 哪怕遇上多人同框、频繁切镜头和大幅度运镜的复杂场面，它的第一视角转换也依然丝滑。 《闻香识女人》里那场著名的探戈，宴会厅人头攒动，原片镜头在全景和近景之间来回切换。 模型从头到尾牢牢锁定阿尔·帕西诺饰演的盲人中校。 生成的第一视角里，中校双手正牵着女伴在白色三角钢琴旁旋转，手部骨骼与乐手方位分毫不差。 换到1952年《雨中曲》的倾盆大雨街头，吉恩·凯利撑着黑伞仰头转圈。

topic_dossiers.topic_title: 浙大彭思达：具身智能与三维视觉

members.title: 浙大彭思达：从元宇宙到具身智能，一个三维视觉研究者的八年 | 世界模型50人
members.content: 八年研究，两个落地系统，超六万GitHub Stars。 作者丨李秋悦 编辑丨吴 彤一支女团跳舞，镜头不必再听导演安排，观众甚至能看到拍摄时不存在的机位。传统MV拍摄，摄影机架在哪里，观众看到的就是哪个角度。现在用多台摄像机同时记录舞者动作，再重建出一个三维动态场景，镜头可以任意调换位置；从队形正面绕到侧面，穿过舞者之间，甚至换一个从未真正架设过的机位，重新观看刚才的表演。今年10月，韩国SM娱乐创始人李秀满在新女团A2O LITE的出道活动上，展示了这项名为4D Gaussian Splatting（4DGS）的技术。SM娱乐旗下女团A2O LITE 《NEON》运用4DV.ai的4DGS新技术彭思达对这项技术很熟悉。六年前，彭思达师从浙大教授周晓巍读博，在浙大CAD&CG国家重点实验室的三维视觉研究团队ZJU3DV下研究的就是动态三维人体重建。很快他做的Neural Body入选CVPR 2021最佳论文候选，4K4D把动态场景的渲染推进到4K实时水平，FreeTimeGS把渲染质量推进到可落地的程度。实验室积累的技术后来被一家名为4DV.ai的创业公司采用，出现了在影视飓风的视频里。技术走出了实验室，但彭思达没有继续留在这个赛道。2023年博士毕业后，彭思达选择留校任教，入选浙江大学软件学院“百人计划”研究员，把研究对象从人体换成了街道。

topic_dossiers.topic_title: tiny-voca 文本转语音模型发布

members.title: I made a small English text-to-speech model called tiny-voca. It has 4.5M parameters, two voices, and it runs in your browser. Try it here, nothing is sent to a server: Some facts: - 4,537,291 parameters, 18 MB. This is the whole model, the waveform part is included. - Two voices, one female and one male. 24 kHz. - About 70x faster than real time on 4 CPU threads. - Runs with PyTorch, ONNX, and in the browser. - Trained from scratch in 7.7 hours on one RTX 4090. What I think is different: - Everything is open. Code, weights, the training recipe and the dataset. - Custom phonemizer. - No neural vocoder. The sound is made by a small source-filter synth, which is why it is fast. What is not good yet: - English only, and only these two voices. No voice cloning. - Foreign names and odd spellings are often read wrong. - It can sound a bit synthetic. - The training audio is synthetic too. I made it with Qwen3-TTS, so the model can't sound better than that. Links: - Demo: - Code: - Weights: - Dataset: - Phonemizer:

topic_dossiers.topic_title: System One 模型评测结果

members.title: SO-Arena scored 21 System One models, and the most accurate one ranks only seventh on reliability. System One models pick from fixed options in one forward pass, so teams use them for routing, tool choice and verification. A leaderboard score does not say whether the pick survives shuffled options or a missing right answer. SO-Arena (2,919 tasks, 11 domains) measures that separately. 🔍 What's new • Reliability R = sqrt(S*N). S is stability over 12 option reorderings. N = 2AUC-1 on spotting that the correct option was removed • JevAny-27B is the most reliable System One model yet ranks eleventh in capability • 14 of 18 models reach S above 0.8, but N runs from near chance to about 0.8 📊 The numbers • GPT-6 Sol (82.3) and Luna (79.7) lead. The best System One models, GLiDE and KnowLine-31B, score 70.2 • Open-weight System One models answer within 0.3 s per task on one H100 • Knowledge, sentiment, retrieval: comparable to Luna, with little gain from a bigger backbone or thinking • Math: thinking lifts StartLux Auto from 50.8 to 92.5. In intent, safety, tools and web, the larger backbone helps far more ⚠️ Caveats • The backbone gain mixes size with Qwen3.5 vs Qwen3.8. Thinking is tested on one model • Two closed System Two references only, and no independent replication yet Before adopting a model, check per-domain scores, then reorder options and drop the correct one on your own task. The MIT repo ships the scoring and reliability tooling. Do you test decision models for order sensitivity before putting them in an agent? 📚 Read it elsewhere • The deep dive on Medium: • The long read on Substack: • The thread on X: • Every version on sajjadpsavoji.github.io:

members.title: SO-Arena: Benchmarking the Capability Spectrum and Reliability of System One Models
members.content: Abstract SO-Arena evaluates System One models across domains and capability families, revealing that scaling and reasoning gains vary and that high overall accuracy does not ensure reliable decision-making. System One models promise fast, general-purpose decision-making without lengthy token generation. However, understanding their capability spectrum and decision reliability requires more than aggregate performance on current benchmarks. Existing evaluations often provide limited insight into the breadth of model capabilities and the reliability of their decisions.

members.title: HiVe-Mem: Interleaving Horizontal Memory Expansion and Vertical Evidence Composition for Multimodal Agents
members.content: Published on Nov 9 Authors: , , , , , , Abstract A novel multimodal memory framework enhances long-term interaction by combining relational graph expansion of semantic seeds with query-adaptive composition of heterogeneous evidence forms. As multimodal agents accumulate increasingly long interaction histories, effectively retrieving and utilizing past information becomes critical for long-term interaction.

members.title: PhysLoop: Harnessing LLMs' Physics Awareness for Self-Improving Video Generation Models
members.content: Published on Nov 12 #3 Paper of the day Authors: , , , , , , , , , , , , Abstract PhysLoop leverages large language models to guide video generation, selection, and correction, enabling physically consistent self-improvement and controllable data construction for video models. Video generation models produce visually realistic videos but still struggle with physical dynamics and causal consistency. Learning from generated videos requires fine-grained physical supervision, yet reliable quality judgments, correction pairs, and controlled variations are difficult to obtain.

members.title: A Cross-Scenario Survey and Analysis of Self-Evolving Multimodal Agents
members.content: Published on Nov 10 Authors: Abstract A survey analyzes why self-improvement mechanisms for multimodal agents transfer unevenly across reasoning, generation, navigation, and manipulation scenarios, framing them as trade-offs over scarce factors and task-structural resources. Recent work shows that multimodal agents increasingly self-improve without recurring human annotation. However, each self-improvement mechanism is designed and evaluated within a single scenario, leaving its preconditions unverified under cross-scenario transfer.

members.title: Duo: A Reciprocal World Model for Full-Duplex Interaction
members.content: Published on Nov 11 Authors: , , , , , , , , , , , , , , , , , , Abstract A reciprocal world model enables real-time full-duplex audiovisual interaction by jointly modeling intent and realization using autoregressive reasoning, synchronized attention, and dual rollout distillation. In this report, we introduce the Reciprocal World Model (RWM) and present Duo v1, a full-duplex world model that continuously perceives audiovisual inputs while responding to users in real time. The RWM treats intelligence and physical reality as equally fundamental to what constitutes a world.

members.title: EgoX: Egocentric Cross-Embodiment Manipulation with Embodiment Dreaming
members.content: Published on Nov 12 Authors: , , , , , , , , , , , , , , , , , , , , Abstract EgoX is an egocentric cross-embodiment learning framework that pretrains a modular Transformer with embodiment dreaming on heterogeneous human, robot, and simulated demonstrations, then fine-tunes it to improve manipulation task progress, especially under out-of-distribution conditions. Generalist manipulation policies can benefit from the complementary experience of humans, real robots, and simulated agents.
